name: Violet Township (Fairfield County) — unincorporated
office: Violet Township Zoning / Building, 10190 Blacklick Eastern Road, Pickerington, OH 43147
source: violet.oh.us zoning and building pages, checked 2026-10-28. Forms and setbacks NOT yet in the toolkit.

applies_when.note: Fairfield County tax district 037 (VIOLET TWP - CANAL WINCHESTER LSD) and other Violet Township districts without a CORP suffix. Many have Canal Winchester or Pickerington mailing addresses.

applications.name: Zoning Permit
applications.form_note: Apply on the OpenGov portal. Plans and the application are checked against the Violet Township Zoning Resolution.
applications.when: before building, remodelling or adding on
attach: site plan with lot lines, setbacks and the addition

applications.name: Building Permit
applications.form_note: Township building department — work that erects, enlarges, alters, repairs, moves, improves, converts or demolishes a structure.
applications.when: always for additions, structural changes, new openings, roof changes, demolition

applications.name: Fairfield County Health Dept — septic / well review
applications.form_note: Ask: bedroom count increase or building over the septic field / near the well usually triggers a review.
applications.when: property on well and septic and (bedrooms added or footprint grows)
